entities.summary: The University of St. Gallen (HSG) is a public research university located in St. Gallen, Switzerland, that specialises in business administration, economics, law, international affairs, and computer science. It was established in 1898. It consistently ranks as one of the best business schools in Europe. In 2022, it had 9,590 students, of which 3,757 were master's students and 584 were doctoral students. Gallen is a research university in Europe, established in 1898. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
